Network.summary: Record a page load's requests and bodies, then throttle or block traffic.
Network.notes: Listen to Network.requestWillBeSent, responseReceived and loadingFinished before Page.navigate: Network events are not replayed on a late enable. A body is readable after loadingFinished.

Fetch.summary: Pause matching requests, then fulfill, modify, fail or continue each one.
Fetch.notes: Fetch is never enabled automatically. Each paused request arrives as Fetch.requestPaused and stays paused until answered; call Fetch.disable when done.

Debugger.summary: Set a breakpoint, wait for the pause, inspect the frame, then resume.
Debugger.notes: Wait for Debugger.paused (it carries callFrames) before evaluating. Always resume: a paused page stops responding.

Profiler.summary: Sample JavaScript CPU time, or collect precise coverage, around an action.
Profiler.notes: Profiler.stop returns the whole profile; save it whole. Stop precise coverage with Profiler.stopPreciseCoverage.

HeapProfiler.summary: Collect garbage, then take a full heap snapshot delivered as chunk events.
HeapProfiler.notes: Append every HeapProfiler.addHeapSnapshotChunk until takeHeapSnapshot answers; a partial snapshot does not load.

Tracing.summary: Record a Chrome trace and read it from the returned stream to EOF.
Tracing.notes: Tracing.end answers before the data: wait for Tracing.tracingComplete, which carries the stream handle. Read IO.read until eof, then close.

Storage.summary: Measure quota and usage, read cookies, track databases, or clear an origin.
Storage.notes: Reading cookies and clearing data need the user's permission. IndexedDB, CacheStorage and DOMStorage read details per origin or storage key.

Emulation.summary: Emulate a device viewport, touch, media features, CPU speed or user agent.
Emulation.notes: Overrides last only for the connection that set them: use one plan. Emulation.setUserAgentOverride and setTimezoneOverride need the user's permission.

CSS.summary: Read the computed style and matched rules of an element.
CSS.notes: CSS.enable needs DOM enabled first. A selector with no match returns nodeId 0.

DOM.summary: Walk the document tree, find nodes, read HTML and box geometry.
DOM.notes: nodeIds are valid only until the document changes; pierce: true crosses shadow roots and frames.

DOMSnapshot.summary: Capture the whole DOM with layout, styles and paint order in one call.
DOMSnapshot.notes: Rows reference a shared strings table by index. Save the result whole; it is large on real pages.

Accessibility.summary: Read the accessibility tree: roles, names and values of every node.
Accessibility.notes: Partial and query calls take a DOM nodeId from DOM.getDocument.

Page.summary: Navigate, read the frame tree and layout, and capture screenshots or PDFs.
Page.notes: Wait for Page.loadEventFired after navigate. Page.reload, stopLoading and crash change the page; the file: scheme needs the user's permission.

Target.summary: List targets, attach to one with a flat session, and drive it by sessionId.
Target.notes: Send child commands with the returned sessionId and detach when finished. For workers and iframes call Target.setAutoAttach before the activity.

Security.summary: Observe security state and certificate errors of a page load.
Security.notes: Listen to Security.visibleSecurityStateChanged. Ignoring certificate errors needs the user's permission.

ServiceWorker.summary: Watch service worker registrations and versions, then stop or unregister one.
ServiceWorker.notes: Existing registrations arrive as ServiceWorker.workerRegistrationUpdated and workerVersionUpdated right after enable.

WebAuthn.summary: Add a virtual authenticator, store credentials and let a page sign in.
WebAuthn.notes: Every credential command needs the user's permission. Remove the authenticator when done.

Audits.summary: Collect DevTools issues, run the form check and read re-encoded images.
Audits.notes: Existing issues replay as Audits.issueAdded after enable; listen first.

Animation.summary: Observe animations, change playback speed, pause or seek them.
Animation.notes: Animation ids come from Animation.animationStarted: listen before the page animates.

Media.summary: Record media player events and properties of a page that plays media.
Media.notes: Listen to Media.playerEventsAdded, playerPropertiesChanged and playerMessagesLogged; there are no media commands beyond enable and disable.
